description: This file defines functions related to stream resolution and management for embedded agents, including caching, strategy description, API key resolution, and stream function selection based on various parameters.

methods.name: resolveEmbeddedAgentBaseStreamFn
methods.description: Resolves and caches the base stream function for an embedded agent session.

methods.name: resetEmbeddedAgentBaseStreamFnCacheForTest
methods.description: Resets the cache for embedded agent base stream functions, primarily for testing purposes.

methods.name: describeEmbeddedAgentStreamStrategy
methods.description: Determines the streaming strategy based on provided parameters such as current stream, provider stream, WebSocket usage, and model provider.

methods.name: resolveEmbeddedAgentApiKey
methods.description: Resolves the API key for an embedded agent, either from a provided value or via an auth storage.

methods.name: resolveEmbeddedAgentStreamFn
methods.description: Selects and returns the appropriate stream function based on various parameters including provider stream, WebSocket usage, model provider, and current stream.
